info.title: Fenergo Nebula Covenants & Conditions Command API
info.description:
**Covenants & Conditions Command API**:


Covenants & Conditions Command API provides endpoints in order to manage and configure all related models and their versions.


**Covenants & Conditions Command API provides**:
  • The ability to manage Covenant Condition Set.
  • The ability to manage Covenant Condition Version.
